content.content:
## Writing in English

Writing is an important skill. In English, you might need to write emails, letters, stories, or messages. In this chapter, you will learn how to write different types of texts.

content.title: Writing Emails
content.content:
**Email structure:**

**Subject line:** Short description of what the email is about

**Greeting:**
- Hi [Name], (informal)
- Dear [Name], (formal)

**Body:** The main message

**Closing:**
- Best wishes,
- Kind regards,
- See you soon!

**Your name**

content.title: Writing Letters
content.content:
**Letter structure:**

1. **Your address and date** (top right)
   15 Main Street
   Oslo, Norway
   January 15, 2024

2. **Greeting:** Dear [Name],

3. **First paragraph:** Say why you are writing

4. **Main paragraphs:** Your message

5. **Last paragraph:** End politely

6. **Closing and signature:**
   Best wishes,
   [Your name]

content.title: Useful Phrases for Writing
content.content:
**Starting:**
- I am writing to tell you about...
- Thank you for your letter/email.
- I hope you are well.

**Middle:**
- First of all...
- I also wanted to say...
- Another thing is...

**Ending:**
- I hope to hear from you soon.
- Write back soon!
- Take care!
- Looking forward to your reply.

content.title: Example: An Email to a Pen Pal
content.problem: Write an email to your pen pal telling them about your school.
content.solution:
**Subject:** My school in Norway

Hi James!

How are you? I hope you are doing well. Thank you for your last email - it was great to hear about your life in England!

I am writing to tell you about my school. My school is called Fjord School, and it has about 300 students. My favourite subjects are English and Art. We have very nice teachers.

After school, I usually play football with my friends. Do you play any sports?

Write back soon!

Best wishes,
Emma

exercise.task: Put these email parts in the correct order:

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: Emma, Best wishes, Hi Tom!, Your email made me happy., Write back soon!
subTasks.solution: Hi Tom!, Your email made me happy., Write back soon!, Best wishes, Emma

exercise.solution: Hi Tom! → Your email made me happy. → Write back soon! → Best wishes, → Emma

exercise.task: Write a short email (5-7 sentences) to a friend telling them about your weekend plans.
exercise.solution: Answers will vary. Should include greeting, body with weekend plans, and closing.
hints: Start with Hi [Name]!, end with Best wishes, [Your name]

exercise.task: Write an email to an English pen pal. Introduce yourself (name, age, where you live), tell about your hobbies, and ask them three questions.
exercise.solution: Answers will vary. Should include self-introduction, hobbies, questions, proper email structure.
hints: Use the phrases you learned: I am writing to..., I hope to hear from you...
